offline.qualification: The actual hosted maintained download test compared the downloaded and committed HTML with a fresh current-source build, then played and reopened the file offline; all passed. New frozen browser tests also executed the historical comparison in a fresh directly opened generated HTML.

remainingLimits: Direct screenshot pixel inspection remains pending supported artifact transport; no visual acceptance is claimed.
Desktop Chrome and Chrome touch emulation were executed; physical-device and actual screen-reader acceptance are separate.

Portable watch-file #12, Reset review #15/PR20, optional sound #16 and readable report #18 are separately owned. This receipt binds current c442 plus our exact source; unintegrated owner compositions and file-open races are not claimed.
